questions.prompt: What does the programme suggest by moving from everyday chores to the UN Women figures?

options.label: A
options.text: All couples divide chores in exactly the same way.

options.label: B
options.text: Only people without paid employment do domestic work.

options.label: C
options.text: An ordinary household issue reflects a wider inequality in unpaid work.

questions.prompt: What is the primary focus of the ARUNGI project as described?

options.label: A
options.text: Replacing every washing machine on the island.

options.label: B
options.text: Encouraging women to leave all outdoor work to men.

options.label: C
options.text: Changing attitudes about women's roles through work with community leaders.

questions.prompt: Why does the reporter challenge the idea that men's field work makes the division fair?

options.label: A
options.text: Women also help in the fields while doing the household tasks.

options.label: B
options.text: Men are no longer involved in any paid work.

options.label: C
options.text: Cooking and childcare are no longer needed on the island.

questions.prompt: Why is the example from Croatia introduced after the Indonesian project?

options.label: A
options.text: To show that wealthy countries have already solved the problem.

options.label: B
options.text: To show that unequal unpaid work is not limited to traditional societies.

options.label: C
options.text: To argue that the two countries have identical household equipment.

questions.prompt: What is the broader value of giving mothers time to take a breather?

options.label: A
options.text: Rest is presented as a substitute for all future employment.

options.label: B
options.text: Sharing chores creates room for their careers, interests and recovery from work.

options.label: C
options.text: The project expects mothers to stop making household decisions.

questions.prompt: What common outcome do the two projects associate with men contributing more?

options.label: A
options.text: Happier households.

options.label: B
options.text: An end to every disagreement between partners.

options.label: C
options.text: The disappearance of all unpleasant chores.
